steps.title: What this does
steps.confirm: I understand that this lets agents see and, with my approval, control other computers.
steps.body:
Runs a small MeshCentral server inside this connector. Computers you install its helper on can then be seen by your agents (pictures and facts) and, when you approve a session on your phone, controlled (commands, mouse and keyboard).

The server is reachable only over your private Tailscale network. Each agent starts at **Look**; raising an agent to **Act** or **Drive** is your choice, and every session needs your approval.

steps.title: Install
steps.body: The connector installs a pinned copy of MeshCentral from its own lock file. Nothing is installed on any other computer in this step.

steps.title: Your settings
steps.body: Enter this computer's tailnet name and tailnet address (both are shown in the Tailscale app), then choose which agents may use remote computers and at which level.

steps.title: Check the server
steps.body: Checks that the server is running and that its device group exists.
